item.title: How IDF helicopter crews reach wounded soldiers in the heart of battle
item.summary: As troops fight Hezbollah in southern Lebanon, Israeli Air Force crews and Unit 669 carry out high-risk rescue missions, landing under fire to evacuate wounded soldiers as quickly as possible; 'We as pilots can literally see the enemy with our own eyes'

item.title: Lebanese president urges talks with Israel as IDF strikes Hezbollah targets in Beirut’s Dahieh
item.summary: Joseph Aoun says negotiations are the only way to stop devastation as Israel expands strikes against Hezbollah; no ceasefire response yet, he says, warning Lebanon risks the fate of Gaza while regional tensions continue to escalate

item.title: Israel braces for major escalation as Trump’s Iran deadline nears
item.summary: With Trump’s ultimatum set to expire early Wednesday Israel time, officials are preparing for possible strikes on Iranian energy and infrastructure targets, even as mediators race to secure a last-minute deal and avert a wider regional war

item.title: Trump: ‘We got him’ after US commando rescue of downed navigator deep inside Iran under heavy fire
item.summary: US forces carried out two-day operation involving hundreds of troops, airstrikes and firefights to extract F-15E navigator; aircraft malfunction forced dramatic changes as all forces exited Iran safely, officials say

item.title: Israel set to start striking energy facilities in Iran next week, official says
item.summary: Senior defense official tells Reuters Jerusalem is waiting for green light from US as Donald Trump issues 48-hour ultimatum to Tehran

item.title: Haifa missile strike tests rescuers in exceptionally complex operation
item.summary: Emergency crews and Home Front Command units spent hours working through unstable rubble at a collapsed residential building, where terrain and an unexploded Iranian missile added to the danger

item.title: Woman seriously wounded after Iranian missile barrage on central Israel
item.summary: At least two other people were wounded in Tel Aviv; authorities said at least one of the missiles was a cluster-type munition, prompting searches for several possible impact sites

item.title: More than 10 impact sites reported in Haifa after latest barrage; no injuries reported
item.summary: Sirens sound in Haifa area following launches from Iran after multiple waves hit central Israel earlier

item.title: 2 bodies recovered after Iran missile strike on Haifa home, 2 still missing
item.summary: Rescue teams worked through the night, recovering two bodies from under the rubble while continuing the search for two people still unaccounted for; 82-year-old man in serious condition and taken into surgery; 8 other people lightly wounded, including a baby

item.title: From automatic support to political risk: Israel is now a burden for Democratic Party candidates
item.summary: Less than three year to US presidential elections and just a few months before the midterms, almost all Democratic leaders are making clear their aversion to Israel and openly talking about breaking away from it - and are saying things about Israel that were once unimaginable
